summary: composer.layout: 'stacked' puts the editor on its own row and the toolbar items in a row under it; the default 'inline' keeps today's single row.
howTo: Set composer: { layout: 'stacked', toolbar: { start: ['plus', 'trigger:@', 'trigger:/'], end: ['mic', 'send'] } } on AiChatProvider. The row is div[data-component="composer-toolbar"][data-layout="stacked"] with toolbar-start and toolbar-end. components.ComposerToolbar still replaces both layouts. See references/composer-triggers-toolbar.md#layout.
